as_told.title: Aligned transients of 27 July 1952 and triple transient of 19 July 1952

plain: The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, who searches old photographic sky surveys for points of light that appear once and then vanish, tells Michels about two such finds from July 1952: five objects lined up on a narrow band, on a plate from 27 July, and a "triple transient", three star-like points found by her colleague Enrique, on a plate from 19 July. She tells it as her own team's work and also credits colleagues she names as Dave Altman and Lash, and Michels reads the same description out himself in an earlier episode. If the points are real objects, they would be things in the sky that no one has explained.
